## Owner-word issues wake an idle project: `routines/owner-word-wake.md`

An owner-word issue was acted on only while a coordinator was awake: listed at the start of a run and on every
report, so an issue filed while no run was in flight waited for the next session (#81).

- **New routine `routines/owner-word-wake.md`.** Set up once per repository as a scheduled task with a GitHub trigger
  on issues (opened, labeled), a fresh session per event. It lists the open `owner-word` issues, acts only on those
  whose author can write to the repository, claims each with a comment so two fires never both act, and hands the
  issue to the coordinator's session or, with no coordinator reachable, carries it out itself (manual mode: it only
  comments that the issue waits for the owner). It never releases or deploys: a release word is recorded for the
  next run.
- **New `workflow.json` key `autonomy.ownerWordWake`:** `"routine"` (the routine is set up), `"heartbeat"` (only the
  roadmap heartbeat, while a run works) or `"none"`. The routine cannot be read from the repository, so the project
  declares it.
- **Doctor:** note `owner-word-wake-undeclared` for an autonomous project without the key; failure
  `owner-word-wake-invalid` for any other value.
- **Installer** prints the one-time setup steps until the key is declared.
- **Docs:** WORKFLOW §2, §8.6 and §13, the rules block, `routines/README.md`, README.

Adopting apps in autonomous mode: after the bump, set up the routine with the prompt in `routines/README.md` and set
`autonomy.ownerWordWake` in `context/workflow.json` (`"routine"`, or `"heartbeat"` / `"none"` to declare that you do
not), then run `npx softure-skills doctor`.
